metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded per participant as a single combined file comprising eyes-open and eyes-closed resting baselines followed by ~17 s exposure segments to jungle and deconstruct soundscapes. Data were released as recorded with only EPOC X hardware bandpass filtering applied (no additional software filtering), and recording timestamps were removed. Events.tsv files mark segment boundaries, and participants.tsv contains liking ratings and baseline-state survey items. A processed, EEGLAB-ready derivative of the two soundscape conditions is provided as per-condition .set files.
